label: MeshBoatGuard Security Stack
info:
Main Node-RED flow for MeshBoatGuard Ground Station:
- JSON packet ingestion via MQTT (self-hosted Mosquitto)
- Telegram push notifications on Alarm
- Telegram remote commands (/arm, /disarm, /status) via MQTT downlink
- Time-series and event writing to InfluxDB v2

name: Extract JSON from Meshtastic Envelope
